Name: RainWorld Slugcat Pets
Author: Librareis
Description:
[size=5][u][u][size=5]FEATURES[/size][/u]
[/u][size=3]
♦ Adds 9 new slugcat pets from the game Rain World!
♦ Currently adds Survivor, Monk, Hunter, Gourmand, Artificer, Rivulet, Spearmaster, Saint and Nightcat
as different slugcat variants, but more slugcats are planned in the
future
[size=5][size=3]♦ Integration with Hats On Pets Plus, letting slugcats wear hats properly[/size][/size]
♦ Optional config to replace regular cats with slugcats as well (retextures them)[/size][u]
[/u][size=5][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=5][size=3]♦ [/size][/size][/size][/size]Regular cats can also be retextured into slugcats with the Alternative Textures version of the mod (AT conversion by RiviRi)[/size][/size][u]

UPDATES
[/u][/size][b]
[size=4][b][size=4][b][b][size=4][b][size=4][b]1.4.0:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][/b][/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][size=4][size=4][size=3]♦ [/size][size=3]Added [/size][/size][/size][size=3]Nightcat
[/size][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=3]♦ [/size]Fixed front-facing sprites to show arms better[/size][/size][/size][/size][b][size=4][b][size=4][b][b]
[/b]
1.3.3:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][size=3]♦ [/size][/b][size=3]Added a version by RiviRi for Alternative Textures! Available as a seperate file. This also retextures cats into slugcats, but does so using Alternative Textures instead of the config.[/size][b]

[/b][size=4][b][size=4][b]1.3.0:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][size=3]♦ Added compatibility with Hats On Pets Plus! Slugcats can now wear hats properly!
[size=3]♦ Added Chinese translation, courtesy of MM1186MM[/size].
♦ Minor tweaks and improvements in other places.[b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[size=4][b][size=4][b]1.2.4:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3]♦ Added 2 new slugcat variants: Spearmaster and Saint!
♦ Updated and improved all slugcat sprites. Slugcats will now flop down their tail when sitting![/size][b][size=3][b]
[/b][/size]
1.2.1:[/b][/size][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]
♦[/size][/size][/size][/size] Fixed a bug with slugcat animations not working!

[size=4][b]1.2.0:[/b][/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3]♦ Slugcats are now their own independent pet-type for real this time! Also fixed the slugcat meow not working properly for
custom slugcats.[/size]
[/size][/size][/size][size=4][b]♦ [/b][b]NOTE:[/b] If you owned a custom slugcat (and not a cat-reskinned one) prior to updating the mod to 1.2.0, it will turn into a default cat!
This is sadly a consequence of me optimizing how the code works, so you will have to adopt a new slugcat, or turn on cat-reskins if you want a slugcat again!
[/size]
[size=4][b]1.1.1:[/b][/size][size=3]
♦ Added gourmand! There are now 6 total slugcats. Like the rest of the slugcats,
he can be chosen at the start of game or bought from Marnie (Or he can replace one of the normal cat variants via config)
♦ The optional toggle to replace normal cats is [u]now off by default.[/u] Can be turned on in the config!
[b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b]1.1.0:[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[/b]♦ Slugcats are now their own pet and don't replace cats! They can be chosen at the start of the game and adopted from Marnie.
♦ Added configuration! You can now toggle to replace cats and keep the old functionality of the mod, if that's what you prefer.[/size]

[size=4][u]CREDITS
[/u][/size]
[size=3]♦ Textures and code by Libraries.
[size=3]♦ [/size]Chinese translation by MM1186MM.
♦ Slugcat noise from the Rain World OST by Bright Primate (James Primate/Therrien & Lydia Esrig).
♦ Slugcats belong to Videocult and Rain World.

[size=4][u]KNOWN ISSUES

[/u][/size][/size][size=3]♦ Hats have been fixed for custom pet slugcats but I am still working on fixing it for reskinned slugcats.[/size]
